definitions.explanation: Describes a person or action characterized by paying close attention and taking care to avoid mistakes or danger.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{注意深|ちゅういぶか}い{人|ひと}だ。
{注意深|ちゅういぶか}く{説明書|せつめいしょ}を{読|よ}んでから{組|く}み{立|た}てた。
examples.english: I carefully read the instructions before assembling it.

examples.japanese: {注意深|ちゅういぶか}い{観察|かんさつ}のおかげで、{小|ちい}さな{異変|いへん}にも{気付|きづ}くことができた。
examples.english: Thanks to careful observation, I was able to notice even small irregularities.

notes:
USAGE:
The adverb form is {注意深|ちゅういぶか}く. A relatively formal adjective, more common in writing than casual speech where {気|き}をつける or {慎重|しんちょう} might be preferred.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {注意深|ちゅういぶか}く{観察|かんさつ}する (to observe carefully)
- {注意深|ちゅういぶか}い{人|ひと} (a careful person)
- {注意深|ちゅういぶか}く{読|よ}む (to read carefully)
